notes.subject: ol tausen bilong ol ten tausen
notes.rationale: Blessing counts offspring in thousands of myriads — a numeric blessing echoing 22:17

notes.subject: kisim dua bilong banis
notes.rationale: 'Possess the gate of his enemies' = conquer their cities; gate stands for the whole city

notes.subject: את (yu)
notes.rationale: Second את here is the pronoun 'you' (H859), not the object marker H853 — easily confused

notes.subject: ol birua
notes.rationale: שנאיו is 'those hating him', rendered as enemies/birua per the hate=enmity table

translation: Na ol i branim ⟨את⟩ Rivka, na ol i tok long em: Susa bilong yumi, yu ⟨i⟩ kamap ol tausen bilong ol ten tausen, na pikinini bilong yu bai kisim ⟨את⟩ dua bilong banis bilong ol birua bilong en.
